name: checkbox-group
title: Checkbox group
description: Several independent choices to one question in one frame (Base UI CheckboxGroup): an optional parent row that checks or clears all with a count, rows with description and meta, Form participant.
whenToUse: Use it for several choices that answer one question, with an All row that counts them. For one yes-or-no choice use Checkbox; for one choice of a few use Radio group.

parts.name: CheckboxGroup
parts.description: Several independent choices that belong to one question, in one frame, built from the parts above. - Behaviour is Base UI CheckboxGroup in a Fieldset in a Field: Tab visits each box, Space toggles, the parent row checks or clears every enabled option; disabled options keep their state. - Field participant: `name` puts the checked values in Form values and FormData, `validate` and Form `errors` reach it, and `invalid` + `error` show the attention state (red frame, the message below). - The parent row is the group's summary, so it is divided from its options by a 2px rule (the same weight a toolbar group's edge has): one unit, then its parts. - Each row's whole width is the hit target (the label wraps the box); long labels wrap inside the row.

props.name: children
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>
props.description: Extra rows (CheckboxGroupItem) after the options, for rows the options shape can't describe.

props.name: layout
props.description: control (default): its own 2px frame, legend above. cell: rows of an enclosing frame (a panel body, a popover).

props.name: legend
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>
props.description: Names the group (a fieldset legend). With layout="cell" it is announced but not shown: the enclosing frame's header names it.

props.name: name
props.description: Form name: Base UI Form values and FormData get the checked values under it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: (value: string[], eventDetails: { reason: "none"; event: Event; cancel: () => void; allowPropagation: () => void; isCanceled: boolean; isPropagationAllowed: boolean; trigger: Element | undefined; }) => void
props.description: Called with the checked values and Base UI's event details (the reason, the event).

props.name: selectAll
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>
props.description: A parent row that checks or clears every option (Base UI's parent checkbox: mixed while some are checked). true labels it "All"; pass a node to name it ("All carriers"). Its meta cell counts "3/5".

parts.name: CheckboxGroupFrame
parts.description: The frame of rows: they meet on 1px keylines, and the parent row meets its options on a 2px rule.

parts.name: CheckboxGroupItem
parts.description: One row: box cell · label (+ description) · optional meta cell. The row is Base UI's Field.Item, its label is the whole row (the hit target), and every Checkbox prop (`value`, `parent`, `disabled`) goes to the box.

props.name: className
props.description: Goes to the row (Base UI's Field.Item); a function receives its state.

props.name: description
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>

props.name: label
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>

props.name: meta
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>

parts.name: CheckboxGroupLegend
parts.description: Names the group: Base UI's Fieldset.Legend, in the field label's voice. Visually hidden in the `cell` layout.

parts.name: CheckboxGroupRoot
parts.description: Base UI's CheckboxGroup, rendered as a fieldset inside its own Base UI Field.Root (the two in one part): `name`, `invalid`, `validate` and `validationMode` go to the field, so Form values, FormData and Form `errors` reach the group; the rest (`value`, `defaultValue`, `onValueChange` with Base UI's event details last, `allValues`, `disabled`) to the group. Lay it out with CheckboxGroupLegend, CheckboxGroupFrame and CheckboxGroupItem rows.

props.name: layout
props.description: control (default): its own 2px frame, legend above. cell: rows of an enclosing frame; the legend is announced but not shown.
